title: 511 Straight Games… Then ZERO Points 🥶 #shorts
description:
Trae Young scored in all 511 games of his NBA career… until Houston. On Nov 15, 2026 the Rockets held him to 0 points on 0-of-5 shooting in a 147-119 blowout 🥶 First scoreless game of his career.

Houston's defense… or is Ice Trae melting? 👇

#shorts #traeyoung #wizards #rockets #nba #basketball #kevindurant #amenthompson #nbahighlights

segments.vo: Trae Young scored in five hundred eleven straight NBA games. Last night, that streak died.
Four-time All-Star. Ice Trae. Traded from Atlanta to Washington in January.
Every single game of his career, he put points on the board. Hawks or Wizards, it didn't matter. He always found a way.
Twenty-six minutes. Five shots. Five misses.
Zero points. The first time in his entire career.
He still dished eight assists, but the Rockets ran Washington off the floor, one forty-seven to one nineteen.
Amen Thompson had twenty-six. Kevin Durant added twenty-five. The Wizards lost their seventh straight.
Was this Houston's defense, or is Ice Trae melting? Tell me below, and follow for more.
